A JSON API with the contract first: api/openapi.yaml written from the model, the server generated by ogen and mounted at /api/v1, and each module's HTTP part, which translates between the contract and its use cases. Errors are Problem Details: a request that does not match the contract, an Accept without JSON, a body that is not JSON or is too large, and the module's refusals. With testcontainers, the operations get tests through the whole contract.

```esquadro
blueprint rest
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [http](../http/), [store](../store/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [i18n](../i18n/), [rate_limit](../rate_limit/), [testcontainers](../testcontainers/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | `""` | Title of the API in the contract; the app's name when empty. |
| `max_body_kb` | int | `1024` | Largest request body, in KB; 0 turns the limit off. &lt;APP>_MAX_BODY_KB overrides it. |
| `pagination` | list | `["cursor", "page"]` | How lists page, unless an entity says otherwise: cursor (after, limit, next), page (page, per_page, total) or both; [] lists every record, up to unpaged_max. |
| `unpaged_max` | int | `1000` | The most records a list without pagination answers; above it, the list answers too_many_records. |

```esquadro
blueprint rest {
  title ""
}
```

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<APP>_MAX_BODY_KB` | int | the max_body_kb option | The largest request body the API reads, in KB; 0 is no limit. |

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| entity | `pagination` | list | How the entity's list pages: cursor, page, both, or [] (none). |
| entity | `unpaged_max` | int | The most records its list answers without pagination. |

An annotation is written `@rest(key value)` on the element.

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `rest.tags` | Tags of your own operations in api/openapi.yaml, indented by two. |
| `rest.test.dependencies` | Code in the API tests' newTestServer that sets more of d, the dependencies, given t and pool. |
| `rest.test.handler` | Code in newTestServer that wraps h, the service's handler, before the test server serves it. |
| `rest.paths` | Paths of your own operations, indented by two. |
| `rest.schemas` | Schemas of your own operations, indented by four. |
| `rest.security.schemes` | Security schemes, indented by four, under components.securitySchemes. |
| `rest.middleware` | Middleware of the API in newAPI, before ogen's server, one per line ending with a comma; d is the dependencies, operations ogen's server. |

## Hooks

- `post-gen` ogen, writes `internal/apigen/**`
